title_en: An unexpected activist emerged to help block a $5 billion data center in Maryland
title_zh: 一个意想不到的激进分子出现，帮助阻止了马里兰州一个价值50亿美元的数据中心

paragraphs.en:
Taylor Frazier McCollum has been active in the opposition to the possible data center at the site of the demolished Landover Mall in Prince George's County, less than a mile from where she lived. If the project is built, the development could occupy more than 80 acres.
 
 
 Tyrone Turner/WAMU for NPR
 
 
 hide caption
paragraphs.zh:
泰勒·弗雷泽·麦科勒姆一直积极参与反对在乔治王子县已拆除的兰德欧弗购物中心旧址上可能建设的数据中心。该地点距离她曾居住的地方不到一英里。如果该项目建成，开发面积可能超过80英亩。


泰隆·特纳/WAMU为NPR拍摄


隐藏说明文字

paragraphs.en: The overgrown grass and weeds seem to stretch into the horizon on nearly 90 acres of empty land in Landover, Md. It used to be Landover Mall, but that closed in 2002, and the site has been mostly vacant since.
paragraphs.zh: 马里兰州兰德欧弗近90英亩的空地上，疯长的野草似乎一直延伸到地平线。这里曾是兰德欧弗购物中心，但该购物中心于2002年关闭，此后这片场地大部分一直空置。

paragraphs.en: "I was like, 'Oh, hell no,'" said Taylor Frazier McCollum, describing the moment she learned about the project. She lived less than a mile away from it. "Why would you want to bring water-polluting, diesel-generating data centers right down the street from where people live, work, play? It just didn't make sense to me."
paragraphs.zh: “我当时就想，‘哦，绝对不行，’”泰勒·弗雷泽·麦科勒姆在描述她得知该项目时的反应说道。她住的地方距离该项目不到一英里。“你为什么要把污染水源、靠柴油发电的数据中心建在人们生活、工作、娱乐的街道旁边？这对我来说根本说不通。”

paragraphs.en: Frazier McCollum is one of a number of Americans whose political awakening was triggered by data center development. Across the country, community members have taken to local council hearings to voice their opposition. They've prompted — though estimates vary — about 500 moratoriums on data centers nationwide.
paragraphs.zh: 弗雷泽·麦科勒姆是众多因数据中心开发而触发政治觉醒的美国人之一。在全国各地，社区居民纷纷前往地方议会听证会表达反对意见。据估计（各方估计不一），他们已促使全国约500个数据中心被暂停建设。

paragraphs.en: Unlike a lot of land-use activists trying to protect their homes from threats in their backyards, Frazier McCollum does not own a home. In 2024, she and her young daughter were evicted from their apartment. She was working at a waxing center that cut wages, and she could no longer cover her rent.
paragraphs.zh: 与许多试图保护自家后院免受威胁的土地使用活动人士不同，弗雷泽·麦科勒姆没有自己的房产。2024年，她和年幼的女儿被赶出了公寓。她当时在一家脱毛中心工作，那家中心削减了工资，她再也付不起房租。

paragraphs.en: "It was difficult," Frazier McCollum recalled. "Because I created the ideal life paying for us to live in this apartment and have our own space ... and then to have it taken away ... It felt like something that wasn't ever going to end."
paragraphs.zh: “那很难熬，”弗雷泽·麦科勒姆回忆道。“因为我曾创造了一种理想的生活，为我们支付这套公寓的房租，让我们有自己的空间……然后这一切被夺走……感觉像是永远不会结束的事情。”

paragraphs.en:
Taylor Frazier McCollum in front of her grandfather's home, where she lived when she heard about the proposed data center site less than a mile away in Landover, Md.
 
 
 Tyrone Turner/WAMU for NPR
 
 
 hide caption
paragraphs.zh:
泰勒·弗雷泽·麦科勒姆站在她祖父家门前。她得知不到一英里外兰德欧弗拟建数据中心选址的消息时，就住在这里。


泰隆·特纳/WAMU为NPR拍摄


隐藏说明文字

paragraphs.en: She created a petition that gathered over 25,000 signatures, leading to widely attended protests and culminating in multiple local moratoriums imposed on data centers throughout the county. It blocked the $5 billion project that was set to break ground between 2026 and 2027.
paragraphs.zh: 她发起了一份请愿书，收集了超过2.5万个签名，引发了参与人数众多的抗议活动，最终促使全县多个数据中心被暂停建设。这阻止了那个原定于2026年至2027年间破土动工、耗资50亿美元的项目。

paragraphs.en: The fight pushed Frazier McCollum to the forefront of local politics. She went to county meetings, testified before Maryland legislators and endorsed political candidates. She found herself in a coalition of socialists, environmentalists, people angry about their electric bills and neighbors new to organizing.
paragraphs.zh: 这场斗争将弗雷泽·麦科勒姆推到了地方政治的前沿。她参加县里的会议，在马里兰州议员面前作证，并为政治候选人背书。她发现自己置身于一个由社会主义者、环保主义者、对电费感到愤怒的人以及刚参与组织活动的邻居们组成的联盟之中。

paragraphs.en: But with data centers paused, some in Prince George's County worry about declining tax revenue. Last year, a local Six Flags closed . The NFL's Washington Commanders announced plans to return to neighboring Washington, D.C. Thousands of federal workers have lost their jobs. The county faces a budget deficit.
paragraphs.zh: 但随着数据中心建设被暂停，乔治王子县的一些人担心税收会减少。去年，当地一家六旗乐园关闭了。美国职业橄榄球大联盟（NFL）的华盛顿指挥官队宣布计划迁回邻近的华盛顿特区。数千名联邦雇员失去了工作。该县面临预算赤字。
